response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of full-stack experience, strong coverage of the primary stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React), demonstrated AI agent development including MCP tooling, and deep testing culture (TDD, test frameworks he authored). Gaps are minor: no explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin experience, though Java is listed and his polyglot background suggests fast ramp-up. Note that he currently works at re:cinq, which may warrant clarification on the application context.
